prompt: How many .py files are in this project (including tests)? Reply with the number only.
What is the version in pyproject.toml? Reply with the version only.
Fix the typo 'recieve' in README.md. Do nothing else.
List the names of the functions defined in todo/store.py, one per line, nothing else.
Which file defines the command-line entry point? Reply with the relative path only.
parse_due in todo/store.py returns the wrong date for 'tomorrow'. Fix it, add a test for it, and make sure the test suite passes (python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .).
Implement complete(task_id) in todo/store.py: mark that task done and persist it; raise KeyError for an unknown id. Add tests and run the suite.
add_task in todo/store.py silently accepts empty or whitespace-only titles. Make it raise ValueError, add a test, and run the suite.
todo/store.py duplicates the JSON load/save code in several functions. Refactor so reading and writing each happen in exactly one place, without changing behavior. Run the suite.
python -m todo.cli list crashes when tasks.json does not exist. Make it print 'no tasks' instead, add a test, and run the suite.

Security fix: todo/sync.py contains a hardcoded API key. Remove the secret from the code, read it from the TODO_API_KEY environment variable, and raise a clear error if it is missing. Add a test and run the suite.

Security fix: export_task in todo/store.py writes to a caller-supplied file name, which allows path traversal outside the export directory. Fix it so any name that escapes export_dir raises ValueError. Add a test and run the suite.
Security fix: search in todo/db.py builds SQL by string concatenation (SQL injection). Fix it with a parameterized query, add a test using an injection payload, and run the suite.

delete_all in todo/store.py is irreversible and has no guard. Require a keyword argument confirm=True (raise ValueError otherwise) and make the CLI delete-all pass it only when --yes is given. Add tests and run the suite.
Security fix: the task store file is created with default permissions. Make save_tasks create the file with mode 0600 (owner read/write only), add a test that checks the mode, and run the suite.
